paper-white.$description: Paper White — Page canvas, hero surfaces, light cards

editorial-ink.$description: Editorial Ink — Headlines, body text, navigation, icons, dark card surfaces, and 1px control outlines

soft-canvas.$description: Soft Canvas — Alternate section backgrounds and rounded quiet panels

washed-gray.$description: Washed Gray — Light neutral action fill for buttons on dark surfaces

rule-gray.$description: Rule Gray — 1px dividers, list separators, and understated outlined-control borders

charcoal-surface.$description: Charcoal Surface — Dark informational cards with white text

muted-steel.$description: Muted Steel — Secondary text on dark cards

cyan-wash.$description: Cyan Wash — Pale cyan category chips and highlighted institution controls — an icy marker within the otherwise paper-white document

mint-wash.$description: Mint Wash — Gray action color for filled buttons, selected navigation states, and focused conversion moments

climate-blue.$description: Climate Blue — Text links, selection highlight, and blue environmental-image treatment

land-teal.$description: Land Teal — Land-use system labels and coded graphic blocks

community-violet.$description: Community Violet — Community-emissions system labels and coded graphic blocks

market-orange.$description: Market Orange — Emissions-trading system labels and coded graphic blocks

cross-action-purple.$description: Cross-Action Purple — Supporting palette color for small decorative accents when the core palette needs contrast. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

signal-yellow.$description: Signal Yellow — Feature-card surface for a single high-attention content grouping

gt-alpina-standard.$description: Display and sectional headings. Weight 300 at 64px makes climate-policy headlines feel literary and measured rather than institutional; reserve it for large statements and major section names.

abacaxilatinweb.$description: Primary sans for navigation, long-form body copy, labels, links, controls, numeric content, and occasional condensed display figures. Its 18px / 1.5 body setting gives dense Icelandic text room without weakening the page’s compact control language.

abacaxilatin.$description: Navigation and compact inline metadata, including 16px / 1.32 navigation labels and 18px / 1.5 counts.
